snippet: THE BLOCK: World Liberty Financial proposes a $WLFI governance staking program set to launch by Oct. 1, 2026. The proposal would require holders to stake WLFI for 180 days and vote at least once every 90 days to remain eligible for rewards from a pool that may be topped up bi-weekly.
